notes.title: OOPS ALL NPCs - Devlog Quickfire
notes.notes:
[p]Embers, today’s all about NPCs! Tour Morcha's cozy house interior, meet a bunch of new villagers in a chilled photo montage, and jump into our community Pixel Art Challenge (running now through Oct 3 on Discord). We also spotlight a few day-one “Lantern” submissions from the community. 
[/p][previewyoutube="KmFDFfblpQM;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: WHO IS THIS NPC? - Emberville Quickfire Devlog!
notes.notes: [p]MINI DESCRIPTION FOR MINI UPDATE! Find out who our latest NPC is and a couple of announcements for our community! [/p][previewyoutube="XIWu3NXNrl0;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: WELL IF IT ISN'T THE CONSEQUENCES OF OUR OWN ACTIONS - Devlog Quickfire
notes.notes:
[p]Mo here with a dense quickfire! Today we: peek into Renato’s SFX workflow for the biome 2 mob boss Nirios, shout out a community-built Discord music bot that streams the Emberville soundtrack, unpack why our character creator explodes the number of unique pixel animations we need, and show Felipe’s procedural dungeon generation revamp 
[/p][previewyoutube="Q0fVRO92V54;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: LET ME TELL YOU ABOUT OUR NEWEST ADDITION - Devlog Quickfire 4
notes.notes: [p]Embers, welcome back! Today’s quickfire hits three big beats: meet Negadra , tour the freshly-finished interior of her house, dive into character creation, and say hello to our new Community Manager, Angie! Drop your theories about the mysterious object in Negadra’s home down in Discord. [/p][previewyoutube="H32aQp16s_Y;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: NEW EMBERVILLE MERCH AND MORE!
notes.notes:
[p]Embers, we’re back! After a quick beach recharge, we’ve got a packed update: meet Aerith, peek at Vitromotus from the outside, see new merch in progress from Camilo, celebrate 100,000 Steam wishlists, and spotlight Rory’s brilliant fan mockups
[/p][previewyoutube="BpXBoVwvKtQ;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: HOT NEW EMBERVILLE LORE JUST DROPPED
notes.notes:
[p]In this week’s quickfire, We unveil the community-chosen name, spotlights Charlie’s moody concept art of Khaldor the EverLiving, a mini BTS on building a destroyed tavern, and peeks under the hood at our new loot/drop-table data structure.
[/p][previewyoutube="D5uJmO_PCCc;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: New Trailer + CohhCarnage Spotlight!
notes.notes:
Hello Emberville Adventurers!

We’re thrilled to share some exciting updates from the world of Emberville. Whether you're a longtime supporter or a newcomer, there's plenty to look forward to!

CohhCarnage, our Executive Producer, recently showcased Emberville’s latest gameplay live on stream! Missed it? Don’t worry—you can still catch the action and see how the game has evolved by watching the replay.

 [previewyoutube=XQBZrCO7Ack;full][/previewyoutube]

We’re incredibly proud of what Emberville has become, and your continued support and feedback have been invaluable on this journey. After watching the trailer and Cohh’s stream, let us know your thoughts—we’d love to hear from you!

🔥 Adventure Awaits in Emberville! 🔥
